name: Title Cases
description: displays a node title using a configured title-case style.
project_description:
Features 
 The purpose of this module is to convert the display of titles using a language writing style guide such Associated Press (AP).

 Apply a title case from a language style guide for the selected content type node titles. The Title Case module only alters the presentation display of the title field and does not change the stored title field value.

 New! 
 Feature to apply the Title Case to the HTML title tag. 
 Node teaser configuration setting that will apply the title case node teasers. 
 
 Post-Installation 
 Configure the Title Cases module by navigating to Administration > Configuration > System. There is a link on the configuration page.

 Additional Requirements 
 The Drupal core Node module is required and is enabled by default.

 Displays a node title using a Title Case from a style guide after configuration.

 Block titles (subject field) and View titles are not affected. However, this is

being considered for future development.

 Drupal, browser, and other cache may need to be cleared after enabling.

 Created using 100% recycled electrons and without AI.
